i.norm: Verifies that a Tag constructed directly (not registered in any TagSet) is equal to itself, and is not considered a "known" tag. Tags are only marked as known when added to a TagSet or when set() is called on them. A plain constructor call leaves the Known option unset.
Create a custom tag with an unconventional name and namespace ("]") to ensure the tag is not matched by any built-in TagSet entry.
A tag must be reflexively equal to itself (equals contract).
Tags created via the constructor are not registered in any TagSet, so the Known option bit is never set — isKnownTag() must be false.
